Adds NOW-refresh (2024-2026) events, web-grounded entity lifecycle dates incl. idea conception/formulation/naming, consolidation dates for harvest/action-space items, rival fates, and DISCLOSED-PROXY theory_dna shares. NEVER duplicates base fields. Keys match base ids EXACTLY (roots.people_0[].who, weld.parents[].name, relatives.edges[].name, harvest.*.name/domain). theory_dna shares are ESTIMATES (historiographic consensus), not measured bits; all confidences SOFT in [0,1].

now_extension.what: Mendel bicentennial (b. 20 Jul 1822) drove a wave of reappraisal scholarship — PNAS 'Mendel and Darwin' / 'Lock and Key in Evolutionary Biology' series and Frontiers bicentennial editorials reframing Mendel as the inheritance mechanism Darwin lacked; revives the dormancy/role-reframing question in this specimen.

Extended Evolutionary Synthesis (EES) debate consolidated philosophically — Shan 2024 (Philosophy Compass) maps the EES-vs-Modern-Synthesis dispute across three domains (empirical epigenetics, historical characterization, conceptual) and argues they are distinct but NOT incommensurable paradigms. Keeps W_C 'active-contested', not closed.

A 'survival of the luckiest' framework (2025) critiques BOTH the Modern and Extended syntheses for under-weighting additional randomness/contingency beyond drift — a new contesting child pressing on the selection-centric core.

Ancient-DNA polygenic-score studies (e.g. directional selection on polygenic traits in eastern Eurasia; allelic-turnover effects on PRS accuracy, Am J Hum Genet 2025) extend Fisher's 1918 infinitesimal model into deep-time selection inference — the action_space 'GWAS/quantitative genetics' lineage actively harvesting in 2024-26.

Epigenetic / transgenerational-inheritance results keep the once-dropped Lamarckian rival in partial, mechanistically-bounded revival via the EES (niche construction, developmental plasticity, epigenetic inheritance) — a disclosed niche persistence of a defeated rival, not a return of soft heredity.

Charles Darwin.named: 1859-11-24 ('natural selection' published in On the Origin of Species)

R.A. Fisher (1890-1962, England), J.B.S..formulated: Fisher 1918 (reconciliation paper); Fisher 1930, Haldane 1924-32, Wright 1931-32 (population genetics)

Theodosius Dobzhansky (1900-75, Ukraine-.named: Huxley 1942 coined 'modern synthesis' / 'evolutionary synthesis' (Evolution: The Modern Synthesis)

Mendelian genetics / particulate inherit.named: 1905 ('genetics' coined by William Bateson); 'gene' coined by Johannsen 1909

Molecular-clock and neutral tests (Kimur.consolidated: 1968-1983 (Kimura, The Neutral Theory of Molecular Evolution, 1983)

GWAS / quantitative + medical genetics.consolidated: 2007-2020s; actively extended 2024-2025 by ancient-DNA polygenic-selection studies

Evolutionary/genetic algorithms in compu.emerged: 1975 (Holland, Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems)

Extended Evolutionary Synthesis (EES).consolidated: 2015-2024 (Laland et al. 2015; Shan 2024 philosophical mapping); still open

EUGENICS (cultural_harvest, domain other.consolidated: 1900s-1940s (Fisher 1930 eugenic chapters; state sterilization/Nazi programs); discredited post-1945

Lamarckism / neo-Lamarckism (inheritance.when: defeated ~1900-1950 (Weismann's hard heredity); partial mechanistically-bounded niche revival via epigenetics/EES 2007-2026

Symbiogenesis / endosymbiotic theory (co.when: vindicated 1967-1981 (Margulis); now canonical, a cousin not a rival

Mutationism (de Vries's mutation theory;.when: saltationist mechanism faded ~1918-1942 (Fisher weld); discrete-factor core absorbed into S

theory_dna._basis_note: DISCLOSED PROXY. Shares are ESTIMATES of load-bearing contribution to W_C's kernel, grounded in historiographic consensus that the proximate weld was BUILT by population genetics (Fisher/Haldane/Wright) on Darwin+Mendel deep roots — NOT measured gain_v2 bits (no real-corpus pilot exists for this specimen). Shares sum to 1.0 across parents+residue by construction; confidence <= 0.6.

Darwinian evolution by natural selection.basis: Supplies the SELECTION mechanism + descent-with-modification frame; the explanatory engine W_C inherits whole (Provine; Wikipedia 'Modern synthesis'). Estimate, not measured.

Mendelian genetics / particulate inherit.basis: Supplies the DISCRETE, non-blending inheritance that rescues selection from the Jenkin blending objection; the conserved variation selection acts on. Estimate from historiographic consensus.

novel_residue.basis: The SYNERGY byproduct reachable from neither parent alone: Fisher 1918's many-small-loci-sum-to-continuous-variation bridge + Hardy-Weinberg conservation law + the redefinition of 'evolution' as allele-frequency change. Conceptually the gain_v2 quantity; rendered as a disclosed proxy from surprise_confidence (0.9) and the unreachable-reconciliation surprise term, never as measured bits.
